h1: 해커스 어법 제대로 CHAPTER 02 · p.32-33 어법변형문제 정답 및 해설

groups.bar: p.32-33 정답 및 해설 (MINI TEST CH01-02)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) cover → covers / 2) has gotten → have gotten / 3) shocking → has shocked / 4) flying → was flying / 5) still trying → are still trying

items.pre: Its location in the North Atlantic Ocean
items.post: a large area between Florida, Puerto Rico, and Bermuda Island.
items.correct: Its location in the North Atlantic Ocean covers a large area between Florida, Puerto Rico, and Bermuda Island.
items.badge: 수식어가 사이에 있는 주어와 동사의 수 일치 (Chapter 01 POINT 1)
items.explain: 주어 Its location과 동사 사이에 「전치사구 in the North Atlantic Ocean」이라는 수식어가 있지만, 동사는 이 수식어를 제외하고 진짜 주어 location(단수)에 일치시켜야 한다. 따라서 cover가 아니라 covers가 되어야 한다.

items.correct: Many ships and planes have gotten lost there.
items.explain: Many ships and planes는 두 명사가 and로 연결된 복수 주어이므로 동사도 복수형이 되어야 한다. 따라서 has gotten이 아니라 have gotten이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Their pilots had reported problems shortly before they were lost, a fact that
items.correct: Their pilots had reported problems shortly before they were lost, a fact that has shocked investigators for decades.
items.explain: that의 선행사 a fact를 설명하는 이 절은 for decades(수십 년 동안)처럼 과거부터 현재까지 지속되는 영향을 나타내므로 현재완료가 알맞다. 관계대명사절에는 분사가 아닌 완전한 동사가 필요하므로 shocking이 아니라 has shocked가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, another plane carrying 13 passengers, which
items.post: nearby, also disappeared in the same location, and experts still trying to explain why.
items.correct: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, another plane carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby, also disappeared in the same location, and experts are still trying to explain why.
items.explain: 콤마로 삽입된 which절에는 본동사가 필요한데 flying은 분사이므로 단독으로 동사가 될 수 없다. 다른 비행기들이 사라진 것과 같은 과거 시점에 '비행하고 있던' 중이었으므로 과거진행 was flying이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, another plane carrying 13 passengers, which flying nearby, also disappeared in the same location, and experts
items.correct: As the Coast Guard was searching for the five missing planes, another plane carrying 13 passengers, which was flying nearby, also disappeared in the same location, and experts are still trying to explain why.
items.explain: and로 연결된 절의 주어 experts(복수)에 대한 본동사가 빠져 있다. 현재도 계속되고 있는 상황이므로 are still trying으로 고쳐 본동사를 갖춰야 한다.

groups.bar: p.32-33 정답 및 해설 (MINI TEST CH01-02)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) these are collecting → these is collecting / 2) comes → come / 3) volunteer → volunteering / 4) realizing → realize / 5) are → is

items.pre: What we are mainly responsible for at times like
items.correct: What we are mainly responsible for at times like these is collecting donations.
items.explain: What we are mainly responsible for at times like these 전체가 하나의 명사절 주어이며, 명사절 주어는 단수 취급한다. 따라서 are가 아니라 is가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Most of the donations we receive
items.post: in the form of food, clothing, and blankets.
items.correct: Most of the donations we receive come in the form of food, clothing, and blankets.
items.badge: 부분·수량 표현 포함 주어 동사 수일치(2): of 뒤 명사에 수일치 (Chapter 01 POINT 3)
items.explain: Most of the donations처럼 「부분 표현 + of + 명사」가 주어일 때는 of 뒤 명사(donations, 복수)에 동사를 일치시켜야 한다. 따라서 comes가 아니라 come이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: However, other ways to help the group include giving cash and
items.post: , opportunities more valuable than people often realizing.
items.correct: However, other ways to help the group include giving cash and volunteering, opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
items.explain: include의 목적어로 and 앞의 동명사 giving과 병렬을 이루어야 하므로 volunteer가 아니라 동명사 volunteering이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: However, other ways to help the group include giving cash and volunteer, opportunities more valuable than people often
items.correct: However, other ways to help the group include giving cash and volunteering, opportunities more valuable than people often realize.
items.explain: 비교급 than 뒤에 이어지는 절의 주어 people(복수)에 대한 본동사가 필요하다. 분사가 아니라 완전한 동사가 와야 하므로 realizing이 아니라 realize가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: We will send you details on how to help if you contact us online, and every volunteer
items.correct: We will send you details on how to help if you contact us online, and every volunteer is truly appreciated.
items.explain: every는 항상 단수명사와 함께 쓰이고 단수 취급하므로, 주어 every volunteer는 단수로 취급해 동사도 단수형이 되어야 한다. 따라서 are가 아니라 is가 되어야 한다.
